name: browser-vm
description: A platform for building browser VMs: a Linux computer, an editor and a network gate, running entirely client-side

scripts.build:desolate: IDE_URL=${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8080_URL:?port 8080 is not forwarded by desolate} GATE_URL=${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8081_URL:?port 8081 is not forwarded by desolate - rebuild the container} PREVIEW_ORIGINS="${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8082_URL:-} ${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8083_URL:-} ${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8084_URL:-} ${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8085_URL:-}" node tools/build.mjs
scripts.dev:desolate: IDE_URL=${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8080_URL:?port 8080 is not forwarded by desolate} GATE_URL=${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8081_URL:?port 8081 is not forwarded by desolate - rebuild the container} PREVIEW_ORIGINS="${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8082_URL:-} ${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8083_URL:-} ${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8084_URL:-} ${DESOLATE_EXTERNAL_8085_URL:-}" node tools/dev.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p runtime && tsc -p gates/core && tsc -p gates/web && tsc -p gates/node && tsc -p host && tsc -p surfaces/vscode/extension && tsc -p surfaces/vscode/page && tsc -p surfaces/lite && tsc -p surfaces/mcp && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
